title: SessionReference
description: A session's corners against AC's AI on the same car, track and setup (docs/adr/0019-ai-reference-driver.md): the AI's passes on the session's own layout and on a variant of it that is the same physical track (docs/adr/0027-layout-variants.md). Every number is computed by core from stored passes, with the count of passes behind it. Read-only.

car.description: The car's id in the game.

track.description: The track's id in the game.

layout.description: Track layout; empty for single-layout tracks.

setup_hash.description: The setup of the session that is compared: the one asked for, else the setup of the session's latest pass. Absent when the session recorded no setup.

setups.description: Every setup the session drove, with its valid passes, most passes first.

margin_floor_s.description: The smallest margin a corner is classed with, seconds, whatever the AI's spread.

ai_passes.description: Valid AI passes stored on this car and its ai_tracks, on any setup.

ai_tracks.description: The track rows whose AI passes are compared with: the session's own first, then a variant of its layout on the same track (<layout> and <layout>_paddock) whose corner map matches. A read-side grouping; no row is rewritten.

variant_note.description: Why a variant of this layout on the same track is not compared with (its corner map differs), in words; empty when there is no such variant or it is compared with.

corners.description: Every corner of the session with a valid pass on the compared setup, by number.

layout.description: Track layout; empty for single-layout tracks.

name.description: The layout's name in the game, such as "COTA F1 2026 (Paddock test)".

variant.description: True for a variant of the session's layout (the same physical track, another track row); false for the session's own.

ai_passes.description: Valid AI passes on this track row, on any setup.

setup_hash.description: The agent's fingerprint of the setup.

passes.description: Valid passes of the session on it.

CornerReference.title: CornerReference
CornerReference.description: One corner: the driver's times, the AI's on the matched setup, the gap and its class.

name.description: The corner's name on the map; empty when it has none.

human_n.description: The session's valid passes of this corner on the compared setup.

human_median_s.description: The typical pass: median zone time, seconds.

match.description: Which AI passes the corner is compared with: on the same setup, on the nearest setup the AI drove, or none.

ai_setup_hash.description: The setup the AI passes were driven on.

setup_changes.description: Items that differ between the compared setup and the AI's (0 on the same setup).

ai_n.description: AI passes behind the AI's numbers.

ai_spread_s.description: 1.4826 times the median absolute deviation of the AI's zone times: a standard deviation that one incident lap does not inflate.

ai_best_session_id.description: The AI session of the AI's fastest pass, for overlaying its samples.

delta_best_s.description: Driver's best minus the AI's median, seconds; positive is slower than the AI.

delta_median_s.description: Driver's median minus the AI's median, seconds; positive is slower than the AI. The class is decided on this.

margin_s.description: The AI's spread or margin_floor_s, whichever is larger.

class.description: driver: the typical pass is slower than the AI's median by more than the margin; car: within the margin or faster; no_reference: too few AI passes to compare.

reason.description: The rule that gave the class, in words.

differences.description: Technique metrics whose medians differ from the AI's by at least their step, largest first, at most three.

metric.description: The engine's metric id, such as brake_dist_m or v_min_kmh.

difference.description: Driver's median minus the AI's, in the metric's unit.

step.description: The smallest difference of this metric that is reported.
